## Guiding us as we grow.

While our processes and practices have changed over time, what we value has remained the same. From day one to today, there have been three deeply ingrained principles guiding all of our actions: Passion, Persistence, and Integrity.

### Passion

Be driven by strong interest, enthusiasm, and dedication to what you contribute both in and outside of work.

### Persistence

Have the tenacity to follow-through on projects and goals, face challenges, and look for new opportunities.

### Integrity

Do the right thing, uphold honesty, and take commitments seriously, both professionally and personally.

## You matter here.

As a company, we are committed to creating an environment and culture where individuals and affinity groups are seen, heard, supported, and empowered. Each of our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) has a dedicated leadership team and executive sponsor that amplifies the voices of ERG members, ensures that each group has effective programming and initiatives, advocates on their behalf for internal change, and advances a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging for the entire organization.

## We take care of our own.

[US benefits](https://info.quantummetric.com/hubfs/US%20Benefits%202023.pdf) [UK benefits](https://info.quantummetric.com/hubfs/UK%20Benefits%202023.pdf)

### Comprehensive health plan.

Medical, dental, vision, and mental health with 99% of the medical base plan paid by the company.

### Commitment to learning.

Grow both professionally and personally with coaching, mentorship, and other learning opportunities.

### Unlimited PTO.

Instead of a fixed number of paid vacation days each year, employees can take the time they need.

### Company equity.

We’re passionate about our work and want everyone to feel ownership over what we do here.

### 401(k) matching.

Employees can invest in their futures with our 3% 401(k) matching program.

### Remote work.

We're a remote-first company, headquartered in Monument, Colorado.

### Quantum Recharge.

After 3 years, employees are given a sabbatical where they can disconnect for 3 weeks.

### Home office + internet stipend.

We offer a one-time work from home stipend and a monthly stipend to cover internet costs.

## In our own words.

“What I love most about being a part of the Customer Success team is that we get to work with some of the top brands in the world. Through our partnerships, we play a significant role in optimizing our customers’ digital experiences. I work with the most passionate, innovative, and supportive people I have ever met and it inspires me to continue to grow each and every day!”

Kat Skuback/Director, Digital & Scaled Program Strategy

“Since joining Quantum Metric, this place continues to exceed all expectations. It is full of the most enthusiastic, genuine and intelligent individuals I have ever met and for me it is the people here that really spur you on to be successful. I am incredibly lucky as I get to share the world of QM with those outside of the organization everyday and it’s a story I will never get bored of telling. My time here has flown by and I cannot wait to see what the future holds! Everyday is a Great Day!”

Simon Fuller/Senior Account Manager

“Opportunity - a single word that best describes a sales career at Quantum Metric via a culture and team full of passion, persistence, and integrity enabling your personal and professional success. You’re the CEO of a territory aligning cross functional teams including leadership to execute on your strategy to expose a new logo client base to industry recognized innovation that delivers real time value via the Continuous Product Design platform and a high caliber Customer Success organization.”

Michael Hanson/Area Vice President, Account Management

“At Quantum Metric, I'm able to work on diverse projects, grow continuously, and share ideas freely. The culture feels genuine and supportive, and the company's focus on mental health creates an environment where I can do my best work.”

Camille Chow/Senior Software Engineer Team Lead

## Global presence.

Talent doesn’t exist in one place. That’s why we have entities in the US, UK, Germany, and Spain and our employees work remotely. Having a global workforce and remote team from different backgrounds fosters an enriching culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Plus, being able to connect with team members from around the world only adds to the strength of our organization.

## A note from our recruitment team.

Quantum Metric will only provide offers of employment and all communications regarding employment from an [\[email protected\]](https://www.quantummetric.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection) email address and/or LinkedIn inMail. Quantum does not recruit via channels such as WhatsApp or Telegram, and will not ask for a candidate’s sensitive information and/or any upfront fees/costs during the job application process. Quantum asks that any candidates report any suspicious recruitment efforts to [\[email protected\]](https://www.quantummetric.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#fa899f998f88938e83ba8b8f9b948e8f97979f8e889399d4999597).
